title: Rabbi Zekharyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A student of Rabbi Ami, as in [Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Sanhedrin.1.1.26): “Rabbi Zekharyah asked Rabbi Ami.” In [Bereshit Rabbah 78:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.78.3) he speaks in Rabbi Acha’s name. He is mentioned in [Sanhedrin 67b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.67b.5), saying: “This shows that Rabbi Yehudah holds that two verses that come as one do teach.” In [Nedarim 32b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.32b.6) he speaks in Rabbi Yishmael’s name. In [Midrash Shmuel 22:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Shmuel.22.5): Rabbi Zekharyah and Rabbi Azaryah spoke in the name of Rabbi Yitzchak bar Maryon.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman names Rabbi Azaryah alongside Rabbi Zekharyah. The Krakow text of Midrash Shmuel reads Rabbi Yonatan bar Chaggai instead. [Heilprin’s Zekharyah notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1143&lang=en) likewise gives Rabbi Yonatan ben Chaggai.
